headline: Witkoff Tangoes Putin ➡️ Miami Zelensky BBQ 🔥🍖
text:
US dealmaker Steve Witkoff 💼🕺 just GRILLED 🔥 Vladimir PUTIN 🐻🇷🇺 for 5 HOURS ⏰😩 in Moscow Kremlin crib 🏰❄️ – ZERO COMPROMISE 💥🚫 on Ukraine war endgame, but Trump 🍊👑 calls it 'REASONABLY GOOD' vibes ✨ with son-in-law Jared Kushner 👨‍💼💍 tagging along like family reunion drama 👨‍👩‍👦! Putin dropping BOMBS 💣: 'DONBAS OR BUST 🗺️🔥 – either we CONQUER 💪⚔️ or Ukies GTFO 🏃‍♂️💨!' Trump spills tea ☕: 'Putin WANTS war over 😌✌️, that's the VIBE boys!' But Ukrainian FM Andrii Sybhia 👨‍💼🇺🇦 RAGING 😡 'WASTING WORLD'S TIME ⏳🤡!' Ambassador Olga Stefanishyna 💃🇺🇦 admits 'NOT MUCH PROGRESS 📉😢' but Ukraine LOCKED IN 🔒 for JUST PEACE 🕊️💪 – Zelensky 🧔🚀 hyping on X 🐦 'REAL CHANCE TO END THIS SHIT 🎉 but PRESSURE RUSSIA HARD 🫸🇷🇺!'

Now Witkoff ➡️ Miami beach vibes 🏖️🍹 THURSDAY 🗓️ to tango 💃🕺 with Ukraine's Rustem Umerov 🛡️ – White House CONFIRMS 📢✅ after Moscow no-deal saltiness 🧂😤! Putin aide Yuri Ushakov 🤵📜 says US proposals 'MEH OKAY 🤷‍♂️' but BIG STICKS 🚫 on territory grabs 🗺️💣 and NATO NO-NO 🚫🇺🇦. Trump already SIMPING? Nah, he HATES NATO invite for Kyiv 😠🚪 – Russia STRONK 💪 from Pokrovsk wins 🏆⚔️, snagging 701 SQ KM 🍑📈 in Nov per ISW nerds 📊🔬, now owning 19.3% Ukraine real estate 🏠🇷🇺!

Putin in camo drip 🪖😎 flexing at command post 📡 claiming city conquests 🏰🔥 – RUSKIES STEPPING UP 🦵📈! Macron 🥐🇫🇷 in Beijing begging Xi 👑🇨🇳 'HELP CEASEFIRE PLZ 🙏🕊️!' Europe BIG MAD 😡 at Putin accusing them of COCKBLOCKING 🛑 US-Russia bromance 👬 – UK calls it 'KREMLIN CLAPTRAP 🤡💩!' NATO boss Mark Rutte 🕶️ in Brussels: 'Talks GOOD 👍 but ARM UKRAINE TO THE TEETH 🦷💥!'

EU cooking €90BN LOAN 💰🔥 for Ukraine guns n' basics using FROZEN RUSSIAN ASSETS 🤑🚫🇷🇺 – Belgium SIMPing out 😰⚖️, ECB NOPE-ing 👎, down from €140BN but STILL THICC 🍑! Putin ready for MORE TALKS 🔄🤝 'AS MANY AS NEEDED ⏳' while Europe DITCHES Rus gas by 2027 🚫⛽ – Trump's 2nd term PEACE DANCE 🕺🍊 or WW3 remix? Zelensky betting on PRESSURE 🔨🇷🇺 to make Putler fold like cheap lawn chair! 💥😂
